sloka: यत् कृते पितरः पुत्रान् जनयन्ति शुभ अर्थिनः ।पर लोक हित अर्थाय तस्य कालो अयम् आगतः ॥१-६२-९॥
transliteration: yat kṛte pitaraḥ putrān janayanti śubha arthinaḥ ।para loka hita arthāya tasya kālo ayam āgataḥ ॥1-62-9॥

translations.english: The very time has now come for that purpose for which parents desiring auspiciousness beget sons—namely, for their welfare in the other world.
